# nico_dpu_machine (Data Source)

A DPU (Data Processing Unit) is a programmable network device installed in a Machine that runs its own operating system, so NICo tracks each DPU as a Machine of its own alongside the host Machine it is attached to. NICo provisions the DPU and uses it to enforce network isolation and Machine trust for the host, including when that host moves between Tenants.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_dpu_machine" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "dpu_machine_name" {
  value = data.nico_dpu_machine.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the resource to retrieve. When set, returns a single resource.
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site

### Read-Only

- `bmc_info` (String) BMC (Baseboard Management Controller) information for the DPU
- `dmi_data` (String) DMI (Desktop Management Interface) data reported for the DPU
- `dpu_agent_version` (String) Version of the DPU agent running on the DPU
- `dpu_network_config` (String) Network configuration fields exposed by the REST API, or null when not requested or unavailable
- `health` (String) Health information for the DPU
- `host_machine_id` (String) ID of the host Machine that this DPU is attached to
- `infrastructure_provider_id` (String) ID of the Infrastructure Provider that owns the host Machine
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Interfaces reported on the DPU (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels associated with the DPU
- `last_rebooted` (String) Last reboot timestamp
- `placement_in_rack` (String) Physical placement of the DPU Machine within its Rack, when known
- `software_components` (Attributes List) Software components reported on the DPU (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--software_components))
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state of the DPU

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `address` (List of String) IP addresses assigned to the interface
- `created` (String) Timestamp when the interface was first observed
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the interface
- `id` (String) Interface ID
- `is_bmc` (Boolean) Whether this interface is a BMC interface
- `last_dhcp` (String) Timestamp of the last DHCP lease for the interface
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the interface
- `machine_id` (String) ID of the Machine the interface belongs to
- `primary_interface` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary interface
- `segment_id` (String) Network segment ID
- `vendor` (String) Vendor of the interface


<a id="nestedatt--software_components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `software_components`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the software component
- `url` (String) URL where the software component can be obtained
- `version` (String) Version of the software component
